notes.title: Update 1 - Moscow map released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33220345/1a400d646bf8a37c88b61971ca50b9da784e0c99.jpg[/img]Your zombies better put some on warm clothes as they're heading to a winter Moscow! New map with new characters and resistance to face. 

- Dynamic snowy weather
- Bears and Zombears!
- New vehicles
- New buildings
- New characters

Get out there and set some new high scores! Remember you must complete the Conquest mode in London to unlock the Moscow playmodes.
